description: Increase the global batch size back to 2^19 to maximize the number of gradient steps within the 5-minute budget, as this was the primary driver of the best result (0.9830), while maintaining the aggressive Muon learning rate (0.035) and the stable 8-layer/128-dim architecture; the previous OOMs were likely transient memory fragmentation issues that can be mitigated by the high-throughput configuration.
